changelog: 📺 Fixed Live Channel Freezing: Tuned HLS sliding broadcast window buffers and added live-edge anti-stall recovery
⚡ Fixed Web Player Breakdown: Prevented native player handoff from destroying web video engine on phones
🛡️ Instant Back Button: Responsive 1-tap exit from player and modals without multi-press lag
🚀 Memory Optimization: Added OS low-memory cache pruning for uninterrupted long streaming sessions
🎬 Fixed TV Series Episode Streaming: Selecting any season and episode (such as Panchayat S2, S3) now streams the exact episode selected instead of locking to Season 1 Episode 1
⚡ Dynamic Episode Server Matching: Episode playback automatically generates and binds to mirror servers specifically configured for the selected season & episode
🏷️ Accurate Episode Badging: Episode list buttons accurately reflect TMDB episode numbers across all seasons
📺 Seamless Hardware Player Integration: Instant native player handoff for all series episodes with multi-audio commentary support
